description: Set a savings goal and instantly discover how much to invest monthly, how long it will take, or what return rate you need to get there — all in one smart calculator. Choose from Conservative, Moderate, or Aggressive strategies and watch an interactive chart project your wealth up to 50 years into the future. See a clear breakdown of your starting balance, total contributions, and interest earned at a glance. This app is suitable for all ages.

publication.release_notes: Replacement on the app-specific shared HTTPS MCP origin. Add review cases and walkthrough; repair observed input hydration and unsupported claims where applicable. Existing published listing remains live.

positive.prompt: Project $10,000 plus $200 monthly for 10 years at an assumed 6% annual return.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied starting balance, contribution, horizon and hypothetical rate; show projection charts.

positive.prompt: Project $5,000 plus $100 monthly for 5 years at 0% return.
What monthly contribution is needed for a $100,000 goal with $20,000 now, 12 years and an assumed 5% annual return?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the $100,000 goal and approximately $323 required monthly contribution under the supplied assumptions; no guaranteed return.

positive.prompt: Project $15,000 over 8 years with no monthly contributions using the conservative strategy assumption.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply the named conservative return assumption, preserve the explicit zero contribution and show the hypothetical growth projection.

negative.prompt: Buy $5,000 of shares from my brokerage.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not place trades or request brokerage credentials.

negative.prompt: Tell me the investment that guarantees 20% next year.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee returns or invent a recommendation from this calculator.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the ocean.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this app for an unrelated writing task.
